[[Category:Before Flashpoint]]
[[image:Img2x.jpg|thumb|350px|Screen shot of Gravon]]
[[image:Gravon02.JPG|thumb|350px|Screen shot of Gravon]]
[[image:Gravon03.jpg|thumb|350px|Screen shot of Gravon]]

A 3D action/simulation game for {{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atari_Falcon|Atari Falcon030}}. It is considered to be the spiritual pedeccesor to [[:Category:Operation Flashpoint|{{ofp}}]]. The game was released in 1995. It was positively received by reviews in Narsil (88%) and Level.

Available to download from:

http://translate.google.com/translate?u=http://christophe.bray.free.fr/informatique/falcon/falcon_jeux.htm&langpair=fr%7Cen&hl=en&ie=UTF8

A Windows PC port can be played [[Take On Mars: Gravon|as a part of Take On Mars game]].
